Forest-style plot of annotated pre-to-post changes

Source: R/change-annotate.R
plotChangeAnnotated.Rd

Draws one row per metric showing the signed change as a point, with the \(\pm\)MDC and \(\pm\)MCID thresholds as symmetric reference bands around the no-change line, coloured by the change classification.

Usage

plotChangeAnnotated(changes)

Arguments

changes

A "change_annotation" object from annotateChange.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

annotateChange()

Examples

# \donttest{
ch <- annotateChange(c(fma = 20, pain = 7), c(fma = 31, pain = 4),
                     mdc = c(5.2, 1.0), mcid = c(9, 2),
                     direction = c("increase", "decrease"))
plotChangeAnnotated(ch)

# }
